intro: Lucknow has only two official UGC-DEB Online MBA providers on this page: the University of Lucknow and Integral University. Both are published on College Decision, and both now have an Online MBA programme row. This is a short, honest list, not a directory of every coaching centre or national brand tagged to the city.

If you are looking for the best Online MBA colleges in Lucknow, these two are the local official options. Several national UGC-entitled universities also offer an Online MBA you can study from Lucknow; they are not Lucknow colleges, and they are not listed as such below. Compare them on the all-India [Online MBA college list](/online-mba-colleges).

sections.h2: Best Online MBA colleges in Lucknow
paragraphs: [Lucknow University](/colleges/lucknow-university-lu-uttar-pradesh-lucknow) is a public, NAAC A++ and UGC Category-1 university. It is on the official UGC-DEB 2026-27 entitled list for an Online MBA, and it is ranked 98 in the NIRF 2025 university category, the latest official NIRF edition at the time of writing. The university’s LUCODE site lists the MBA fee as ₹25,000 per semester, with examination fees as applicable; the exam amount is not published there, so we have not invented it.

[Integral University](/colleges/integral-university-uttar-pradesh-lucknow) is a private university in Lucknow, also on the entitled 2026-27 list. Its official online portal lists a two-year Online MBA, a semester fee of ₹17,000 and a total fee of ₹67,500, with eligibility as a bachelor’s degree from a recognised university. In NIRF 2025 it sits in the university rank-band 101–150, which is not a finer rank inside that band.

sections.h2: What this Lucknow list does not include
paragraphs: Aggregator pages for “top Online MBA colleges in Lucknow 2026” often show national brands, distance diplomas or a Lucknow tag on a Noida or out-of-state university. Those names can be useful to research, but they are not official Lucknow providers on this page. Amity’s official Online MBA record in our database is unpublished and stored against Delhi NCR, so it is not treated as a Lucknow college here.

If you want a wider Uttar Pradesh shortlist, see [Online MBA colleges in Uttar Pradesh](/online-mba-colleges-in-uttar-pradesh). If you want national UGC-entitled options as well, use the [all-India Online MBA college list](/online-mba-colleges). In both cases, match the university name on the current UGC-DEB list before you pay a fee.

faqs.question: How many official Online MBA colleges are there in Lucknow?
faqs.answer: There are two official UGC-DEB Online MBA providers based in Lucknow on this page: the University of Lucknow and Integral University. If a website shows a much longer Lucknow list, check whether those entries are national brands, diplomas or city tags rather than a Lucknow-based entitled or recognised university.

faqs.question: Which is the public Online MBA option in Lucknow?
faqs.answer: The University of Lucknow is the public option. It is NAAC A++ and UGC Category-1, entitled to offer an Online MBA in the 2026-27 UGC-DEB list, and ranked 98 among universities in NIRF 2025. Confirm fees and admission dates on the LUCODE portal, because the published semester fee does not include a stated examination charge.

faqs.question: What is the fee for an Online MBA in Lucknow?
faqs.answer: Integral University’s official online portal lists a total fee of ₹67,500, or ₹17,000 a semester, for its two-year Online MBA. Lucknow University’s LUCODE site lists ₹25,000 per semester plus examination fees as applicable; we have not invented the exam amount. Confirm the payable figure for your intake on the university portal.

faqs.question: Can I do a national Online MBA while living in Lucknow?
faqs.answer: Yes. A UGC-DEB entitled or recognised Online MBA can usually be studied from Lucknow even when the university is based in another state. Those universities are not listed as Lucknow colleges on this page. Use the all-India Online MBA college list to compare them, and still check the official UGC-DEB list.

faqs.question: Do these Lucknow Online MBA programmes require CAT?
faqs.answer: The official pages we checked for Lucknow University and Integral University do not make CAT a mandatory entrance for the Online MBA. Admission is typically based on a recognised bachelor’s degree and the university’s own application and verification steps. Follow the current notice on the university’s online education portal.
